name: io.github.cigalpay/cigalpay-mcp
title: CigalPay
description: Crypto payments: create Bitcoin, USDT and other crypto payment links, track payments and refunds.

environmentVariables.name: CIGALPAY_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your Account ID (dashboard > Settings > API credentials)

environmentVariables.name: CIGALPAY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your API key (dashboard > Settings > API credentials)

environmentVariables.name: CIGALPAY_NOTIFY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Default public HTTPS URL for signed payment notifications

environmentVariables.name: CIGALPAY_ALLOW_REFUNDS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable the create_refund tool
